note: One source for what a plan is (18.5 / 11.3). Read by the migration that
fills the plan table, and - from stage 2 - by the marketing site's build,
so what is offered and what is marketed cannot drift.
Nothing reads this at run time. The application reads the plan table, and
the site renders static HTML at build. A page that fetched its own prices
from JavaScript would have nothing to say with JavaScript off.
ENTERPRISE CARRIES NULL WHERE A NUMBER WOULD BE A PRICE, and the string
the pricing page prints everywhere else. monthly_price_cents is null
because a negotiated price must not be a release (CLAUDE.md, Money); the
site's word for that null is 'negotiated'. It is also the one plan with no
paddle_price_name, because it is not bought in the product.
ENTERPRISE IS NOT A plan ROW, and migration 033 does not make it one.
plan.seat_count, monthly_price_cents and monthly_credit_cents are all NOT
NULL, so a row for it could only exist by inventing three numbers - which
is the release the decision forbids. It lives here, and stage 2 renders it

trial_days_note: How long a trial runs. THE SITE AND THE APP BOTH RENDER THIS NUMBER at
build - the marketing pages through site/plans-table.ts, the application
through ui/src/trial.ts - so there is one number and no prose to keep in step.
IT DOES NOT DECIDE ANYTHING. signup.TRIAL_DAYS is what computes
tenant.trial_ends_at, and the signup Lambda bundles lambda/signup only, so it
cannot read this file. This is the PUBLISHED figure and that is the ENFORCED
one; tests/test_plans_source.py fails if they differ, which is the same
arrangement the plan prices have with the Paddle catalogue.
It read 30 everywhere a customer could see it and 14 in the code, from 17
September until 22 September - including the summary shown immediately before
share_overage_note: What one shared memorandum costs past the plan's monthly allowance, by
plan_key. OUTSIDE plans, so the field list every plan carries is
unchanged. The ENFORCED figures are meter_price's share_overage_base and
share_overage_business rows (migration 036); this is the PUBLISHED copy.
A TRIAL IS BASE'S SHAPE: ten shares once for the whole trial, then the

Sending past the allowance is charged, never refused. A rate limit of 20

field_sets_dropped_note: FIELD SETS PER DOCUMENT TYPE WAS SOLD HERE UNTIL 30 SEPTEMBER 2026 (22.5):
3 on Base, 5 on Small Business, 10 by default on Enterprise. Dropped, not
enforced, because a field set is a schema the editor derives from which
document types each fact is found in - invisible to the tenant and not
theirs to control - and our own base exceeds the limit sold: 19 of tenant
0's 36 types carried more than 3, and one 23. The cost it stood for is
real (extraction reads the document once per set) and is being fixed in
plan.field_sets_per_type stays in the database. Dropping a column is a
separate migration and a separate decision.
